about_the_game:
With this collection of bonus content, you can support the developers of Voidtrain while adding some extra flair to the game. Included in this pack are unique in-game skins and designs that will give your game a fresh, new look. And, of course, our greatest thanks go as an extra bonus!

So, what exactly will you get?

Unique skins that replace standard in-game models:

  • Elegant Hammer
  • Elegant Bracer
  • Elegant Diary
  • The Golden Way (New Rails Design)

Unique decor items for your train:

  • Elegant Chair I
  • Elegant Chair II
  • Elegant Dresser
  • Elegant Floor
  • Leech head
  • Leech Tail
  • Void Train Model
  • Wall Plant
  • Wall Rofleemo
